meta.name: Dogecoin Core Regtest
meta.shortDescription: Private regtest chain with wallet + auto-miner for dApp development
meta.longDescription:
Runs a wallet-enabled Dogecoin Core 1.14.9 node on a private regtest chain — instant blocks, unlimited mined dev coins, no internet or sync required. Ideal for dApp development: fund addresses with generatetoaddress, build and sign raw transactions, watch ZMQ notifications. An optional built-in auto-miner produces a block every few seconds so the chain is always ready.

IMPORTANT: After saving configuration changes, DISABLE and then ENABLE this pup to apply the new settings.

sections.name: RPC
sections.description: RPC server configuration. The node is reachable from other pups via the core-rpc interface, and from your LAN via the host port dogeboxd assigns.

fields.name: RPC_PORT
fields.label: RPC Port (also the host-forwarded port; 24555 avoids clashing with a Core/Gateway pup's 22555)

sections.name: Mining
sections.description: Optional auto-miner: produces one block every N seconds so dev coins are always available. Disable it if you want deterministic, test-controlled block production (then mine manually with generatetoaddress).

fields.name: MINER_ADDRESS
fields.label: Mine to address (empty = a new wallet address)

sections.name: Node Features
sections.description: Indexing and notifications. After saving changes, DISABLE and re-ENABLE this pup to apply.
